evals.name: metaphor-recipe-for-emotion
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing metaphor-recipe I need a metaphor for grief that isn't a storm or an ocean
evals.expected_output: Routes to the metaphor-recipe action. Loads metaphor.md (the 8 named recipes) and templates/metaphor-recipe-prompt.md. Generates 6-8 metaphor candidates avoiding the named cliche families (storm-anger, fire-passion, ocean-sadness) per the user's constraint, labeling each with its type (expressed identity / qualifying / verbal) and a grounding suggestion.
expectations: Avoids storm and ocean (named cliche families) per the user's constraint
Labels each with a metaphor type (expressed identity / qualifying / verbal)
Offers options rather than a single winning metaphor
